name: Solo Copy Blocks
description: Copies blocks and config from the W3CSS theme (or a sub-theme) into the Solo theme.
project_description:
The Solo Copy Blocks module is a dedicated tool designed to facilitate the smooth migration of blocks and their configurations specifically from the W3CSS theme , or any of its sub-themes, to the Solo theme within your Drupal installation. This module is tailored for users of the W3CSS theme and aims to simplify the migration process, ensuring a seamless transition without the headache to Solo Theme.

 
 Back to top 

 🌟 Introducing Solo: The Revamped W3CSS Theme on Drupal! 🌟 
 Hey Drupal Enthusiasts! 

 I'm excited to share that the W3CSS theme has evolved into Solo ! It's sleeker, faster, and packed with new features, now available on Drupal.org. Along with the theme, I've also upgraded the W3CSS paragraphs to the new and improved Paragraphs Bundles , enhancing your content creation experience.

 Why Upgrade to Solo? 

 
 Fresh, modern design 
 Enhanced customization and performance 
 Seamless integration with Drupal 
 
 📥 Download Solo Today! 

 ⭐ Upgrade to Solo – where innovation meets elegance! ⭐
Upgrade with ease and give your website a stunning new look. We'd love your feedback!

 How to Upgrade Part One - Part Two 

 
 Key Features: 

 
 Effortless Migration: Copy blocks with ease from the W3CSS theme or its sub-themes to Solo. 
 Block Sorting: Maintain block order and weight during migration. 
 Theme Compatibility: Exclusively designed for use with the W3CSS theme and its sub-themes. 
 Region Mapping: Automatically map regions between themes for a hassle-free transition. 
 Preserve Block Status: Retain block status (enabled or disabled) during migration. 
 Built with care for users of the W3CSS theme, Solo Copy Blocks is your go-to solution for pleasant and headache-free migrations from the old theme to the new one. 
 
 How to Use Solo Copy Blocks: 

 
 Download and Install the Module: 
 Begin by downloading the Solo Copy Blocks module and installing it on your Drupal website.

 Install the Solo Theme (Without Setting as Default): 
 Download and install the Solo theme. During installation, simply click to install it without setting it as the default theme.

 Copy Blocks to Solo Theme: 
 Navigate to the "Configuration" section in your Drupal admin panel. Under "System," you'll find an option named "Copy Blocks to Solo Theme." Click on it or visit your-site/admin/config/system/solo-copy-blocks . Once there, click the "Copy Blocks" button to initiate the block migration process.

 
 By following these steps, you can easily migrate blocks from your existing theme to the Solo theme using the Solo Copy Blocks module.
